name: Bengali
notes: Bengali has no upper case: caps are not available, so weight carries emphasis.
Conjuncts (যুক্তাক্ষর) make words wider and taller than their character count suggests. line_height must be at least 1.12 or the hasanta and upper matras collide.
Do not add letter spacing beyond 1px: it visually breaks conjunct clusters that belong together.
whisper large-v3 for Bengali; a small English model produces confident nonsense.
Digits are usually Latin numerals on screen, even when the language is Bengali.
Starting defaults, not measurements. Measure three videos in your niche before quoting these numbers.
